title: Earthly Vegan Bowl
description: A simple and flavorful bowl filled with roasted vegetables and served over a bed of rice.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss the carrots and sweet potatoes with a tablespoon of oil and a pinch of salt until they're evenly coated.
Spread the carrots and sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until they're tender and lightly browned.
While the vegetables are roasting, cook the Japanese rice according to the package instructions.
In a small pan, heat a tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms and cook until they're tender and lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, place a scoop of cooked rice in the bottom of a bowl, followed by a portion of the roasted vegetables, some green onions, and a sprinkle of soy sauce.
If using, drizzle the rice vinegar and sprinkle the sesame seeds over the top of the bowl.
